chip.description: 32-bit CISC processor (uPD70632): the V60 architecture widened to a 32-bit address bus and 32-bit data bus.
chip.notes: src/devices/cpu/v60/v60.cpp in MAME 0.288 ("Emulation for the NEC V60 (uPD70615) and V70 (uPD70632) CPUs"), which quotes the NEC Semiconductor Selection Guide for the bus widths.
